messages:
Jun: uploaded replay vs synth numbers for microbatch sweep, weird p99 jump at mb=8 -> mb=4. gcs://redwood-perf/series/1768/results.csv :eyes:
perf-bot: new artifacts uploaded: gcs://redwood-perf/series/1768/ (summary.json, traces.tar.gz)
Matt: was that replay or loadgen?
Jun: replay with inter-arrival reconstruction from prod traces, but we deduped noise. also ran a synthetic poisson load for baseline.
Sara: mb=8 causing kernel selection to switch? we've seen matmul->matmul_v2 path change that adds ~6ms tail sometimes.
Lara: can you paste runtime flags? kernel pin vs auto makes a big diff in our prior run
Jun: runtime cmd we used:
```
./redwood-runtime --model=rw-13b --microbatch=8 --kernel=auto --kv-cache --trace=on
```
Mina: also check KV warmup pattern — replay keeps prefixes longer which hits cold KV->longer memcopies. p99 sensitive to first-row KV misses.
Matt: hmm, so confounding factors: kernel, microbatch, kv warmup, and batching timing jitter. tough to attribute
Sara: suggestion: stratified experiments. run small stratified sample of tail traces (top 1% by seq len) and pin kernel, then run full replay. compare p95/p99 delta. also bootstrap CI for p99.
Jun: agree. i can run kernel=matmul_v2 and kernel=matmul_auto with mb=4/8 and collect per-request kernel tag and KV hit flag
Lara: add a run with continuous-batching disabled (`--batching=off`) to see base latency per token
Mina: for measurement, compute p95/p99 from request-level latency after removing known startup warmup window (first 30s) and apply block-bootstrapping to get CI
Jun: plan: 1) pin kernels (auto, matmul_v2, matmul_slow) x microbatch {4,8,16} 2) replay stratified tail subset 3) full replay 4) synthetic poisson baseline. Volunteers?
Matt: I can take kernel pin runs today
Sara: i'll prepare stratified tail selection script (will include seq_len, prompt_prefix, kv_miss_rate)
Lara: i'll add batching-off run and collect traces
perf-bot: scheduled job created: perf-job-1768; expected completion ~2h
Jun: thx team. please add any extra trace fields you think useful. ping me in thread when you start so i can coordinate result naming :thumbsup:
